bbmp_shroom: csrc/retro/shroom_engine.cpp, self_path.h and engine.h from github.com/creep-ltx/bbmp, commit
19d87098b3716156d80224d22dc49ca22884d1b7, unchanged (GPL-3.0-or-later, SPDX line in each file). Songs of Mario Paint's music editor (.sho), after
Mariopants 1.1 by Brad Smith (credit and change mark are in the engine's header). The instrument sounds are Nintendo's and are NOT vendored,
fetched or shipped: the user supplies Mariopants' data/notes.wav (declared system file mariopants-notes.wav, no download URL).
bshroom_glue.cpp is Selecta's glue: the registry hook, read_file(), find_beside(), the text helpers and debug_on() the engine takes from bbmp-retro's
main program, notes.wav -> note table conversion at load time (port of csrc/retro/shroom_samples.cpp, GPL-3.0-or-later, so that no separate tool
is needed), and a C entry point that renders the song.
Declared system file mariopants-notes.wav: Mariopants 1.1 data/notes.wav, 26936466 bytes, sha256
039f642ea239970f41ed6fe3431f27c156346312ee72184723611951b855b129 (adapter.c SEL_RP_SYSFILE_SHA256). Read from the package
mariopants11src.zip (sha256 468dd5075fa171f38c3a05b3836a8aa2e144b3eba8bf88b7ac98e8b997ab509a), Wayback copy
http://web.archive.org/web/2018/http://rainwarrior.ca/projects/nes/mariopants11src.zip (author's page rainwarrior.ca/projects/nes/mariopants.html,
original link now 404). The package is Nintendo data: never committed, bundled or hosted.
